label: BEING_1 is not a GENUS_1 in the…, from Every GENUS_1 has at least one differentia… and 2 more
description: A three-step reductio over a typed predication structure (terms, genera, differentiae, essential predication); being-not-a-genus is derived, not assumed, and each premise is shown necessary by a countermodel. The conclusion concerns the strict sense of genus only (DISAMB-GENUS).
